answer: Operator Liability Holdback: each agent identity posts a small onyx-denominated deposit, but payout of accrued earnings routes through a relic escrow tied to the operator’s verified real-world account. When a cluster of identities shares one withdrawal destination above a set threshold, the escrow freezes that operator’s entire balance rather than any single wallet. An attacker farming mass identities must therefore split payouts across many costly verified accounts, and one collapse forfeits the oasis of pooled earnings plus the escrow itself.
